description: This file defines types, interfaces, and functions related to inter-process communication (IPC) in the Playwright testing framework. It includes payload structures for test events, configuration serialization, and utility functions.

methods.name: serializeConfig
methods.description: Serializes the full configuration object into a format suitable for IPC, optionally including compilation cache and metadata.

methods.name: stdioChunkToParams
methods.description: Converts a chunk of data (Uint8Array or string) into a TestOutputPayload, encoding buffers as base64.
